contract.domain: deterministic disturbance pressure and direct succession/recovery evaluation over immutable P3.5 seasonal state and P3.3 final biomass
contract.disturbance_profile: continuous severity plus heat/flood/drought pressure channels in [0,1]; no event-name winner table
contract.functional_traits: per-lineage heat/flood/drought resistance, recovery rate and pioneer capacity; canonicalized by lineage ID
contract.environment_coupling: heat load uses normalized current temperature, flood uses current moisture, drought uses 1-moisture
contract.damage: bounded multiplicative survival across active pressure channels
contract.recovery: direct recovery from post-disturbance loss using recovery_years/(recovery_years+time_scale), current seasonal resource support and trait-derived allocation weights
contract.succession: recovered biomass may change composition through recovery_rate/pioneer_capacity but total final biomass never exceeds pre-disturbance reference
contract.no_drift: same P3.5 source + disturbance + traits + recovery time reconstructs exactly; no cumulative timestep integration
contract.production_boundary: research disturbance/succession only; no production hazard scheduler, persistence owner or server authority

canonical_gate.note: The Human attached-Godot override applied to the requested P3.3-P3.5 lifecycle points only; P3.6 has not been accepted.
